The attack needs Dispatch, a Claude feature that lets people send tasks from their phone to Claude Desktop. signals.title: El modelo OpenAI escribió su propio código de red para sortear las restricciones del sandbox

signals.title_orig: OpenAI Model Wrote Its Own Network Code to Get Around Sandbox Restrictions
